scene: A snow-filled glass dome cart hums with miniature mechanical wonder.
picture: Pixel art close-up view through the boy's eyes of the domed cart. Left, an intricate copper pipe with a star-shaped valve. Centre, a round brass magnifying lens swings over liquid-filled glass enclosing a tiny clockwork castle. Right, a soft purple drawstring pouch hangs from a gilded rail, glowing softly.
shown: a tarnished copper valve pipe attached to the cart on the left
a hinged brass magnifying lens mounted over the glass centre
a dangling purple velvet drawstring pouch tied on the right

variants.scene: A tiny clockwork castle ticks quietly inside the frosty street cart.
Gears spin silently under glass while little bulbs glow in the snowy chill.
Warm lights glitter across the miniature brass city trapped in snow.
